import json,sys,tempfile,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path('/Users/yanjixiong/github/mini-loop')
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'python'));sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'python/tools'))
import watchfiles,uvicorn
from watchfiles.main import RustNotify
from watchfiles_contracts import _native_case
assert watchfiles.__version__=='1.2.0' and uvicorn.__version__=='0.49.0'
churn=int(sys.argv[1]);fixture_path=repo/'go/testdata/python-watchfiles.json';cases=json.loads(fixture_path.read_text())['native_events']
result={'churn':churn,'watchfiles_version':watchfiles.__version__,'uvicorn_version':uvicorn.__version__,'fixture_sha256':hashlib.sha256(fixture_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'subscriptions':[],'cases':[]}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mini-loop-source-churn-') as scratch:
 root=Path(scratch).resolve();warm=root/'warm';warm.mkdir()
 for index in range(churn):
  start=time.monotonic();observer=RustNotify([str(warm)],False,False,300,True,True)
  representation=repr(observer);assert 'FsEventWatcher' in representation and 'latency: 0.0' in representation and 'flags: 18' in representation
  observer.close();closed=False
  try:observer.watch(1,1,1,None)
  except RuntimeError:closed=True
  assert closed
  result['subscriptions'].append({'index':index,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'closed':closed})
 for case in cases:
  recipe={k:v for k,v in case.items() if k not in ('changed','closed','native_arguments')}
  start=time.monotonic()
  try:
   observed=_native_case(root/case['name'],recipe)
   sample={'name':case['name'],'changed':observed['changed'],'expected':case['changed'],'matches_fixture':observed['changed']==case['changed'],'closed':observed['closed'],'native_arguments':observed['native_arguments'],'seconds':time.monotonic()-start}
  except Exception as error:
   sample={'name':case['name'],'error_class':type(error).__name__,'error':str(error),'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'matches_fixture':False}
  result['cases'].append(sample);print(json.dumps(sample),flush=True)
output=Path(f'/tmp/mini-loop-source-cli-load-{churn}-2026-10-11.json');output.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('COMPLETE',churn,sum(c['matches_fixture'] for c in result['cases']),len(cases),flush=True)
